objects.name: Large Light Oak Office Desk
objects.description: Large rectangular executive office desk with a thick light oak laminate tabletop and matching wooden front and side panels.

objects.name: Back Wall Wooden Storage Counter
objects.description: Long light oak wooden office counter positioned against the rear wall beneath the window, featuring multiple built-in drawers, lower storage cabinets, metal handles and an open drawer.

objects.name: Grey Mesh Executive Office Chair
objects.description: Ergonomic grey mesh-back office chair with black armrests, padded seat, adjustable height and five-wheel base, positioned behind the main desk.

objects.name: Grey Mesh Visitor Office Chair
objects.description: Grey ergonomic mesh-back visitor chair with curved black armrests, padded seat and black five-star caster base, positioned in the left foreground.

objects.name: Plastic Wrapped Office Chair
objects.description: Grey upholstered office chair with black armrests and wheeled base, partially covered in transparent protective plastic, positioned behind the other visitor chair.

objects.name: Large Black Metal Grilled Window
objects.description: Large rectangular sliding window with dark grey metal frame, multiple horizontal and vertical security bars, translucent daylight-facing glass and a projecting grey stone or metal sill.

objects.name: Multifunction Office Laser Printer
objects.description: Compact black and silver multifunction office laser printer with document feeder, control panel and white paper output tray, placed on the rear-left portion of the main desk.

objects.name: Silver HP Laptop
objects.description: Open silver HP laptop with black keyboard, large display and visible HP logo on the back of the screen, placed near the center of the main desk.

objects.name: Black Smartphone
objects.description: Small black rectangular smartphone with dark glass screen lying flat on the right side of the main desk.

objects.name: Black Office Landline Telephone
objects.description: Black corded office desk telephone with numeric keypad, small digital display, handset and coiled telephone cable, positioned on the rear storage counter.

objects.name: Transparent Acrylic Award
objects.description: Small transparent acrylic commemorative award or plaque with a circular decorative design, standing upright on the rear storage counter.

objects.name: Golden Wooden Trophy Plaque
objects.description: Small oval golden award plaque mounted on a dark brown wooden base, displayed upright on the rear storage counter.

objects.name: Small Personal Photograph Frame
objects.description: Small upright rectangular photo frame with a light-colored border and a personal photograph, positioned beside the trophy.

objects.name: Stack of Office Notebooks and Documents
objects.description: Several stacked colorful notebooks, folders and loose office documents with yellow, blue and multicolored covers arranged on the rear counter.

objects.name: Black Soft Office Bag
objects.description: Soft black fabric laptop or travel bag with shoulder straps, lying horizontally on the right portion of the rear storage counter.

objects.name: Stainless Steel Water Bottle
objects.description: Tall cylindrical silver stainless steel reusable water bottle with a narrow screw-top cap, standing on the far-right section of the rear counter.

objects.name: Printed Office Brochure
objects.description: Flat dark-colored printed booklet or brochure with visible graphic printing, resting near the right-front edge of the rear counter.

objects.name: Wall Mounted Printed Office Notice
objects.description: Small vertically oriented white printed information sheet attached to the rear wall above the office counter.

objects.name: Wall Electrical Outlet
objects.description: White rectangular electrical outlet panel with multiple sockets and connected black power plugs, mounted above the rear counter.

objects.name: Black Laptop Power Adapter and Cable
objects.description: Small black rectangular electrical power adapter with loosely arranged connecting wires, placed on the main desk near the printer.

objects.name: Black Eyeglasses
objects.description: A pair of dark-framed eyeglasses lying open on the wooden desktop.

objects.name: Office Pens and Stationery
objects.description: A couple of individual writing instruments, including a blue pen and a darker pen, lying on the main desk near the laptop and smartphone.
